usage: Use 油站 to mean a petrol station or gas station; it is a very common everyday noun in spoken Cantonese.
It usually appears on its own or with location words like nearby, ahead, or around here when asking for directions.
Common collocations include 去油站, 搵油站, and 入油；the last one is the usual verb for refuelling at a petrol station.
In Hong Kong Cantonese, 油站 sounds natural and neutral, and is the standard word in daily conversation and road-travel contexts.
